nodes.summary: Build a republished corpus into a fresh private output directory
usage: corvint-corpus-republish build --trusted-local --root ROOT --request FILE --policy FILE --expected-policy-sha256 SHA --output-dir DIR [--documentation-root DIR] [--previous-result FILE] [--previous-artifact FILE] [--previous-sidecar FILE]
nodes.example: corvint-corpus-republish build --trusted-local --root ROOT --request FILE --policy FILE --expected-policy-sha256 SHA --output-dir DIR

nodes.summary: Queue a republish request in the private single-writer pending state
usage: corvint-corpus-republish queue --trusted-local --root ROOT --request FILE --policy FILE --expected-policy-sha256 SHA --pending FILE [--documentation-root DIR] [--previous-result FILE] [--previous-artifact FILE] [--previous-sidecar FILE]
nodes.example: corvint-corpus-republish queue --trusted-local --root ROOT --request FILE --policy FILE --expected-policy-sha256 SHA --pending FILE
